name: B10-0424/2026 – After recital G – Am 9
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: Ga. whereas the Council of European Muslims (CEM), formerly the Federation of Islamic Organisations in Europe, is described by the French Ministry of the Interior as the ‘cornerstone of the European structuring’ of the Muslim Brotherhood; whereas it is linked to Europe Trust, described as the ‘financial arm of the movement’ in Europe and registered in the United Kingdom as a charitable organisation; whereas numerous organisations, such as FEMYSO, are linked to the CEM;
